text:
Dokument Nr 393
Bolezlavus dux Polonie 1261 Dec. 10, in Sechowa; confirmat collationes haereditatum et libertatum, monasterio de Ląd a Meschone duce Poloniae a. 1145 occasione fundationis ipsius factas, eisque pro sua parte novas adiicit.
Poznań. Königl. Staats Archiv. Ląd, Lib. privil. B, Nr. 4. (cnfr. diploma Nr. 10, i Ryszczew. Muczkow. Codex diplom. Poloniae I, Nr. 1).
In nomine sancte et individue Trinitatis amen. Quoniam factum omne modernorum haberi solet dubium quod non litterarum apicibus roboratur, ideo nos Bolezlavus dux Dei gracia Polonie mandavimus fratribus domus Landensis Ordinis Cisterciensium, ut nobis super fundacione eiusdem domus sua privilegia exhiberentur. Quibus cum qua diligencia decet examinatis, certo cercius comperimus in eisdem, quod proavus noster Mescho, magnus Dei gracia dux Polonie, premissa domo fundata anno Domini M.C.XL.V, pro sustentacione fratrum ibidem Deo famulancium, ad honorem Domini nostri Iesu Christi et gloriose genitricis eiusdem semper virginis Marie, erogavit predicte domui has hereditates cum hominibus simul et cum omnibus utilitatibus tam presentibus quam futuris: videlicet Koscol ubi concessit esse forum omni libertate plenum, Dolan, Moscho, Cloba, Gocszene. Istarum vero villarum homines tenentur singuli solvere in festo sancti Michaelis LX manipulos siliginis, modium avene, mensuram tritici, tres urnas brasei, quinque capecia annone metere, tria plaustra feni totidemque lignorum, duos truncos de pino; per tres continuos dies cum tota familia segetes purgare, per unum diem singuli triturare, tres kitas lini dare. Contulit et has subnotatas hereditates cum hominibus et omnibus utilitatibus tam presentibus quam futuris: Szethowo cum cocis, Rzgowo cum sanctuariis et stabulariis, Grabienice cum camerariis, Slavsko cum piscatoribus, Wiramowo, Kwaskowo, Chozen, Staralanka, Swiniarowo. Homines vero predictarum villarum tenentur rete trahere inter Seradz et Wladislav; per totam Poloniam, cum necessitas fratrum exegerit, tam equestres quam pedestres, mandata eorum dirigere. Indulsit eciam ut piscatores et venatores predictorum fratrum, piscatores et venatores suos ac posterorum suorum ubique piscando ac venando libere sequantur. Dedit eciam ad lumina acquirenda prefatis fratribus tria fora cum tabernis, videlicet Glev, Thur et Sobotka. Voluit eciam tabernarios predictarum villarum nusquam citari, nisi coram abbate. Quia vero donum Deo collatum legibus principum subiacere non debet, absolvit omnes homines in premissis villis commorantes a powoz, ab omni prewod, a stroza, a dan, naraz, podworowe, targowe, mostne, a castrorum edificio seu poncium quorumlibet, a recepcione vel custodia aut conductu castorariorum, a custodia et solucione erodiorum quod sokol dicitur, a vicinia quod opole vulgariter nuncupatur, ab omni exactione sive colleccione, a vecturis et expedicionibus, et ab omnibus iuribus in Polonia constitutis, quibuscunque censeantur nominibus. Nulli ergo iudicum aut castellanorum scitandi seu iudicandi in prefatis hominibus vel villis eorum ius aliquod reservans. Verum, quia temporis antiquitas res que servando servari nequeunt non sinit statu persistere in eodem, verendumque foret ne, predicto privilegio proavi nostri nimia vetustate consumpto, in posterum iam dicte domui preiudicium generaretur, nos ergo progenitorum nostrorum devocionem pio affectu prosequentes, premissas hereditates cum hominibus ac libertatibus super scriptis confirmamus, in nostram preterea defensionem suscipientes hereditates per nobiles Polonie ipsis hereditario iure collatas, scilicet Skarbossewo, Marcinkowo, Iarossyno, Gorzyza, Zagorowo, Skokom, Oleszyno. Et ob remissionem nostrorum peccaminum absolvimus omnes homines in prefatis villis commorantes, asscripticios, liberos, ac mercenarios in curiis eorum servientes, ab omni iure Polonicali et a colleccione quod powolne (sic) dicitur. Contulimus eciam fratribus sepedictis aquam Wartam cum rivulis adiacentibus, a terminis antiqui castri usque in Dretino episcopi et in alia parte usque in Capayn, cum piscationibus, utilitatibus et castoribus iure hereditario possidendam. Ut autem hoc nostrum factum in honorem Dei sancteque genitricis eiusdem semperque virginis Marie ratum inviolabiliter observetur, presentem cedulam sigilli nostri munimine duximus roborandam, ita videlicet, ut si, quod absit, aliquis posterorum nostrorum vel eciam alienorum huic nostro facto ausu temerario contraire presumpserit, indignacionem Dei omnipotentis nec non beatorum apostolorum Petri et Pauli atque omnium Sanctorum se noverit incursurum. Actum in Sechowa anno Domini M.CC.LXI, quarto Idus Decembris. Adest et fidelium testium astipulacio: Iohannes Dei gracia archiepiscopus Gnezdnensis, Iohannes cancellarius, Erkenboldus Gnezdnensis palatinus, Simon castellanus Gnezdnensis, Matheus Landensis castellanus, Matheus noster notarius, qui et presentem cedulam sigillavit.
Landensis, de Ląd. Koscol, Kościół św. Mikołaja, miejsce, na którem późniéj stanęło. m. Lądek. Dolan, Dolany. Moscho, w Nr. 10 Morsk, Mokra, osada znikła p. m. Kazimierz, lub też Mokre p. m. Rychwał. Cloba, Kłobia. Gocszene, jak się późniéj okazuje Choceń. Szethowo, Szetlewo. Coci, t.j. Villa coquorum, Kuchary Kościelne. Rzgowo, Rzgów. Sanctuarii, t.j. Villa Sanctuariorum, Świątniki. Stabularii, może znikła osada Obory. Grabienice, Grabienice. Camerarii, może znikła osada Komorniki. Slavsko, Sławsk. Piscatores, może osobna, znikła osada Rybitwy. Wiramowo, Kwaskowo, nie odgadnione. Chozen, Chorzeń. Staralanka, Swiniarowo, nie odgadnione. Seradz, Sieradz. Wladislav, Władysławów. Glev, pewnie Galewo. Thur, Tury. Sobotka, Sobotka, Skarbossewo, Skarboszewo. Marcinkowo, późniéj zmienione na Kowalewo. Iarossyno, Jaroszyn. Gorzyza, Gorka. Zagorowo, Zagurów. Skokom, Skokum. Oleszyno, pewnie Oleśnica. Antiquum castrum, stało obok klasztoru Ląd. Dretino episcopi, Drążyn. Capayn, Kopojno. Sechowa, Czechowo, lub też Szetlewo.

pages.reading:
Dokument Nr 393

Bolezlavus dux Polonie 1261 Dec. 10, in Sechowa; confirmat collationes haereditatum et libertatum, monasterio de Ląd a Meschone duce Poloniae a. 1145 occasione fundationis ipsius factas, eisque pro sua parte novas adiicit.

Poznań. Königl. Staats Archiv. Ląd, Lib. privil. B, Nr. 4. (cnfr. diploma Nr. 10, i Ryszczew. Muczkow. Codex diplom. Poloniae I, Nr. 1).

In nomine sancte et individue Trinitatis amen. Quoniam factum omne modernorum haberi solet dubium quod non litterarum apicibus roboratur, ideo nos Bolezlavus dux Dei gracia Polonie mandavimus fratribus domus Landensis Ordinis Cisterciensium, ut nobis super fundacione eiusdem domus sua privilegia exhiberentur. Quibus cum qua diligencia decet examinatis, certo cercius comperimus in eisdem, quod proavus noster Mescho, magnus Dei gracia dux Polonie, premissa domo fundata anno Domini M.C.XL.V, pro sustentacione fratrum ibidem Deo famulancium, ad honorem Domini nostri Iesu Christi et gloriose genitricis eiusdem semper virginis Marie, erogavit predicte domui has hereditates cum hominibus simul et cum omnibus utilitatibus tam presentibus quam futuris: videlicet Koscol ubi concessit esse forum omni libertate plenum, Dolan, Moscho, Cloba, Gocszene. Istarum vero villarum homines tenentur singuli solvere in festo sancti Michaelis LX manipulos siliginis, modium avene, mensuram tritici, tres urnas brasei, quinque capecia annone metere, tria plaustra feni totidemque lignorum, duos truncos de pino; per tres continuos dies cum tota familia segetes purgare, per unum diem singuli triturare, tres kitas lini dare. Contulit et has subnotatas hereditates cum hominibus et omnibus utilitatibus tam presentibus quam futuris: Szethowo cum cocis, Rzgowo cum sanctuariis et stabulariis, Grabienice cum camerariis, Slavsko cum piscatoribus, Wiramowo, Kwaskowo, Chozen, Staralanka, Swiniarowo. Homines vero predictarum villarum tenentur rete trahere inter Seradz et Wladislav; per totam Poloniam, cum necessitas fratrum exegerit, tam equestres quam pedestres, mandata eorum dirigere. Indulsit eciam ut piscatores et venatores predictorum fratrum, piscatores et venatores suos ac posterorum suorum ubique piscando ac venando libere sequantur. Dedit eciam ad lumina acquirenda prefatis fratribus tria fora cum tabernis, videlicet Glev, Thur et Sobotka. Voluit eciam tabernarios predictarum villarum nusquam citari, nisi coram abbate. Quia vero donum Deo collatum legibus principum subiacere non debet, absolvit omnes homines in premissis villis commorantes a powoz, ab omni prewod, a stroza, a dan, naraz, podworowe, targowe, mostne, a castrorum edificio seu poncium quorumlibet, a recepcione vel custodia aut conductu castorariorum, a custodia et solucione erodiorum quod sokol dicitur, a vicinia quod opole vulgariter nuncupatur, ab omni exactione sive colleccione, a vecturis et expedicionibus, et ab omnibus iuribus in Polonia constitutis, quibuscunque censeantur nominibus. Nulli ergo iudicum aut castellanorum scitandi seu iudicandi in prefatis hominibus vel villis eorum ius aliquod reservans. Verum, quia temporis antiquitas res que servando servari nequeunt non sinit statu persistere in eodem, verendumque foret ne, predicto privilegio proavi nostri nimia vetustate consumpto, in posterum iam dicte domui preiudicium generaretur, nos ergo progenitorum nostrorum devocionem pio affectu prosequentes, premissas hereditates cum hominibus ac libertatibus super scriptis confirmamus, in nostram preterea defensionem suscipientes hereditates per nobiles Polonie ipsis hereditario iure collatas, scilicet Skarbossewo, Marcinkowo, Iarossyno, Gorzyza, Zagorowo, Skokom, Oleszyno. Et ob remissionem nostrorum peccaminum absolvimus omnes homines in prefatis villis commorantes, asscripticios, liberos, ac mercenarios in curiis eorum servientes, ab omni iure Polonicali et a colleccione quod powolne (sic) dicitur. Contulimus eciam fratribus sepedictis aquam Wartam cum rivulis adiacentibus, a terminis antiqui castri usque in Dretino episcopi et in alia parte usque in Capayn, cum piscationibus, utilitatibus et castoribus iure hereditario possidendam. Ut autem hoc nostrum factum in honorem Dei sancteque genitricis eiusdem semperque virginis Marie ratum inviolabiliter observetur, presentem cedulam sigilli nostri munimine duximus roborandam, ita videlicet, ut si, quod absit, aliquis posterorum nostrorum vel eciam alienorum huic nostro facto ausu temerario contraire presumpserit, indignacionem Dei omnipotentis nec non beatorum apostolorum Petri et Pauli atque omnium Sanctorum se noverit incursurum. Adest et fidelium testium astipulacio: Iohannes Dei gracia archiepiscopus Gnezdnensis, Iohannes cancellarius, Erkenboldus Gnezdnensis palatinus, Simon castellanus Gnezdnensis, Matheus Landensis castellanus, Matheus noster notarius, qui et presentem cedulam sigillavit.

translation.en:
Document no. 393

Bolesław, Duke of Poland, 10 December 1,261, at Sechowa; confirms the grants of estates and liberties made to the monastery of Ląd by Mieszko, Duke of Poland, in 1,145 on the occasion of its foundation, and adds new ones on his own part.

Poznań. Royal State Archive. Ląd, Liber privilegiorum B, no. 4. (Compare charter no. 10, and Rzyszczewski and Muczkowski, Codex diplomaticus Poloniae I, no. 1.)

In the name of the holy and undivided Trinity, amen. Since every deed of men of our time is wont to be held doubtful that is not strengthened by the points of letters, we Bolesław, by the grace of God Duke of Poland, ordered the brothers of the house of Ląd of the Cistercian Order to show us their privileges on the foundation of that house. Having examined them with due care, we found in them with full certainty that our great-grandfather Mieszko, by the grace of God great Duke of Poland, having founded the said house in the year of the Lord 1,145, for the support of the brothers serving God there, to the honour of our Lord Jesus Christ and of his glorious mother Mary ever Virgin, bestowed on the said house these estates with their people and all their uses present and future: namely Kościół, where he granted that there should be a market full of every liberty, Dolany, Mokra, Kłobia, Choceń. The people of these villages are bound each to pay on the feast of St Michael sixty sheaves of rye, a measure of oats, a measure of wheat, three urns of malt; to reap five heaps of corn, three cartloads of hay and as many of wood, two pine trunks; for three days on end with all the household to clean the crops, each to thresh for one day, and to give three bundles of flax. He also gave these estates listed below with their people and all their uses present and future: Szetlew with the cooks, Rzgów with the sanctuary people and the stable men, Grabienice with the chamberlains, Sławsk with the fishermen, Wiramowo, Kwaskowo, Chorzeń, Staralanka, Swiniarowo. The people of these villages are bound to draw the net between Sieradz and Władysław, and throughout all Poland, whenever the need of the brothers requires, to carry their orders, on horse as well as on foot. He granted too that the fishermen and huntsmen of the said brothers might freely follow fishing and hunting wherever his fishermen and huntsmen and those of his successors go. He also gave the said brothers, for providing lights, three markets with inns, namely Glev, Thur and Sobotka. He would also have the innkeepers of the said villages summoned nowhere but before the abbot. And since a gift given to God ought not to be subject to the laws of princes, he freed all the people living in the said villages from carting, from every conveyance, from watch, from tribute, naraz, podworowe, market and bridge tolls, from the building of castles or of any bridges, from receiving, guarding or escorting beaver-keepers, from the guarding and payment of falcons, which is called sokol, from the neighbourhood called in the common tongue opole, from every exaction or levy, from carting and military expeditions, and from all the rights established in Poland by whatever names they are called. Reserving to no judge or castellan any right to summon or judge the said people or their villages. But since the age of time does not let things which cannot be preserved by keeping stay in the same state, and it was to be feared that, the said privilege of our great-grandfather being worn away by great age, harm might in future arise to the said house, we, following with pious affection the devotion of our forebears, confirm the said estates with the people and liberties written above, and take moreover into our protection the estates given to them by hereditary right by the nobles of Poland, namely Skarboszewo, Marcinkowo, Jaroszyn, Górka, Zagórów, Skokum, Oleśnica. And for the remission of our sins we free all the people living in the said villages, bondsmen, free men and hired men serving in their courts, from every Polish right and from the levy which is called powolne (sic). We have also given the said brothers the water of the Warta with the streams adjoining it, from the bounds of the old castle as far as Drążyn of the bishop and on the other side as far as Kopojno, with the fishing, uses and beavers, to be possessed by hereditary right. And so that this our deed, to the honour of God and of his holy mother ever Virgin Mary, may be kept inviolably ratified, we have had the present document strengthened by the protection of our seal, on this condition: that if, which God forbid, any of our successors or of others should dare with rash daring to go against this our deed, he shall know that he will incur the indignation of almighty God and of the blessed apostles Peter and Paul and of all the Saints. Done at Sechowa in the year of the Lord 1,261, on the fourth day before the Ides of December. There is also the witness of faithful men: Jan, by the grace of God Archbishop of Gniezno; Jan the chancellor; Erkenbold, palatine of Gniezno; Szymon, castellan of Gniezno; Mateusz, castellan of Ląd; Mateusz our notary, who also sealed the present document.

Landensis, of Ląd. Koscol, Kościół of St Nicholas, the place on which later stood the town of Lądek. Dolan, Dolany. Moscho, in no. 10 Morsk, Mokra, a vanished settlement near the town of Kazimierz, or else Mokre near the town of Rychwał. Cloba, Kłobia. Gocszene, as later appears, Choceń. Szethowo, Szetlewo. Coci, that is the village of the cooks, Kuchary Kościelne. Rzgowo, Rzgów. Sanctuarii, that is the village of the sanctuary people, Świątniki. Stabularii, perhaps the vanished settlement of Obory. Grabienice, Grabienice. Camerarii, perhaps the vanished settlement of Komorniki. Slavsko, Sławsk. Piscatores, perhaps a separate, vanished settlement, Rybitwy. Wiramowo, Kwaskowo, not identified. Chozen, Chorzeń. Staralanka, Swiniarowo, not identified. Seradz, Sieradz. Wladislav, Władysławów. Glev, probably Galewo. Thur, Tury. Sobotka, Sobotka. Skarbossewo, Skarboszewo. Marcinkowo, later renamed Kowalewo. Iarossyno, Jaroszyn. Gorzyza, Gorka. Zagorowo, Zagurów. Skokom, Skokum. Oleszyno, probably Oleśnica. Antiquum castrum, stood beside the monastery of Ląd. Dretino episcopi, Drążyn. Capayn, Kopojno. Sechowa, Czechowo, or else Szetlewo.

Coci, that is the village of the cooks, Kuchary Kościelne. Rzgowo, Rzgów. Sanctuarii, that is the village of the sanctuary people, Świątniki. Stabularii, perhaps the vanished settlement of Obory. Grabienice, Grabienice. Camerarii, perhaps the vanished settlement of Komorniki. Slavsko, Sławsk. Piscatores, perhaps a separate, vanished settlement, Rybitwy. Wiramowo, Kwaskowo, not identified. Chozen, Chorzeń. Staralanka, Swiniarowo, not identified. Seradz, Sieradz. Wladislav, Władysławów. Glev, probably Galewo. Thur, Tury. Sobotka, Sobotka. Skarbossewo, Skarboszewo. Marcinkowo, later renamed Kowalewo. Iarossyno, Jaroszyn. Gorzyza, Gorka. Zagorowo, Zagurów. Skokom, Skokum. Oleszyno, probably Oleśnica. Antiquum castrum, stood beside the monastery of Ląd. Dretino episcopi, Drążyn. Capayn, Kopojno. Sechowa, Czechowo, or else Szetlewo.
summary_en: Duke Bolesław of Poland confirms to the abbey of Ląd the estates and liberties Duke Mieszko had given it at its foundation in 1145, and adds new ones. Among them are Szetlew with the cooks, Rzgów with the sanctuary people (Świątniki, in the editors' note), and Zagórów, Skokum and Oleśnica, given to the abbey by nobles of Poland; Kopojno marks a boundary. Sechowa, 10 December 1261. Kodeks Dyplomatyczny Wielkopolski I, no. 393, from the Liber privilegiorum B of Ląd.
summary_de: Herzog Bolesław von Polen bestätigt dem Kloster Ląd die Güter und Freiheiten, die Herzog Mieszko ihm bei der Gründung 1145 gegeben hatte, und fügt neue hinzu. Darunter sind Szetlew mit den Köchen, Rzgów mit den Kirchendienern (nach den Herausgebern Świątniki), und Zagórów, Skokum und Oleśnica, die polnische Adlige dem Kloster gegeben hatten; Kopojno nennt eine Grenze. Sechowa, 10. Dezember 1261. Kodeks Dyplomatyczny Wielkopolski I, Nr. 393, aus dem Privilegienbuch B von Ląd.
